articles.abstract: 预测市场月交易额从 2025 年 8 月的 10 亿美元飙升至 2026 年 7 月的近 460 亿美元，而 Kalshi 八成交易量来自体育合约。文章指出第三巡回法院 KalshiEX v. Flaherty 案认定《商品交易法》优先于州博彩法只是序曲：Murphy v. NCAA 确立的反强制原则与联邦权限清晰声明规则意味着，当合约实质是娱乐性博彩而非风险转移或价格发现时，联邦优先权难以证成。作者主张功能主义分轨：宏观经济与金融变量合约归联邦衍生品监管，体育娱乐合约归州博彩监管或联邦州协调框架，并批评 CFTC 六月提案在功能测试上半途而废。

articles.title_cn: Wachtell Lipton讨论特拉华衡平法院重申Caremark责任取决于恶意的裁决
articles.authors: Cynthia Fernandez Lumermann, Adebola O.M. Olofin, Sijin Choi, Tobias Kuehne
articles.abstract: 解读特拉华衡平法院驳回波音股东派生诉讼的裁决：2018-2019 年 737 MAX 空难后，波音董事会设立航空航天安全委员会、重组安全汇报线并逐会听取安全风险报告；2024 年舱门塞空中脱落事件后，股东仍提起 Caremark 索赔。法院重申 Caremark 责任不以疏忽或重大疏忽为已足，须达不忠诚的恶意，即董事明知未履行信义义务；红旗须与公司创伤足够相似，不能将详尽的风险汇报从最佳实践颠倒为不忠诚证据。裁决确认：针对关键法律义务定制的监督体系加上留痕的善意努力，仍是 Caremark 责任的坚固防线。
articles.abstract_cn: 解读特拉华衡平法院驳回波音股东派生诉讼的裁决编号： 空难后2018-2019 年 波音董事会设立航空航天安全委员会、重组安全汇报线并逐会听取安全风险报告737 MAX 年舱门塞空中脱落事件后， 2024 责任不以疏忽或重大疏忽为已足须达不忠诚的恶意，股东仍提起 索赔。法院重申 即董事明知未履行信义义务Caremark红旗须与公司创伤足够相似仍是 Caremark不能将详尽的风险汇报从最佳实践颠倒为不忠诚证据。裁决确认针对关键法律义务定制的监督体系加上留痕的善意努力 ， Caremark 责任的坚固防线。

articles.title: Different Markets, Different Regulatory Priorities: Insider Trading, Manipulation, and Corruption-Prone Event Contracts in Prediction Markets
articles.title_cn: 不同市场 不同监管重心：预测市场中的内幕交易、操纵与易腐败事件合约
articles.affiliations: Yale Law School; University of Bologna Faculty of Law
articles.abstract: 证券市场与预测市场存在根本差异：前者配置资本、为退休储蓄提供基础设施，后者唯一的社会产品是蕴含于价格中的概率预测信息。这一功能性分野决定了监管重心的反向配置——证券市场严控内幕交易以保护有价值的信息财产权，却少干预相对自我校正的操纵行为；预测市场则应放任合法知情交易以保全其信息功能，对操纵施以更严格规制。文章提出易腐败事件合约（corruption-prone event contracts）概念：合约结算受参与者自身或其影响范围内人员的行为左右，激励结构内生催生操纵。文章援引保险利益的法理逻辑，建议在挂牌阶段即予排除，理由是事后追诉不足以遏制已发生的社会危害。既有挪用、公司、伦理及涉密规则仍管辖真正的背信行为，合法的知情交易者理应自由交易；交易所与 CFTC 应在合约设计环节剔除易腐败事件合约，特别是颗粒度过细、可由市场参与者左右的事件，以及一旦挂牌即引发严重不当行为动机的结果。作者主张抛弃以证券法逻辑监管预测市场的旧范式，转向功能性二元监管。

articles.title: No Leaks, No Litigation: Why Venture Capital Disputes Are Rare in Latin America
articles.title_cn: 无漏洞 无诉讼：为何拉美的风险投资纠纷如此稀少
articles.affiliations: Georgia State University College of Law
articles.abstract: Cable 与 Strauss 近期研究指出美国 VC 行业近四分之一涉及诉讼，呈现液压式压力传导。文章从拉美视角形成强烈反差：表面看似利好投资者，实则掩盖更复杂的故事。原因在于制度架构封闭多条通向 VC 深度口袋的通道——巴西对集体诉讼施加严格代表资格限制，墨西哥要求当事人亲自加入，哥伦比亚股东派生诉讼须经股东会批准，巴西私人持股公司最低持股门槛 5%、墨西哥高达 25%；无美式发现程序，无陪审团压力。仲裁虽存在但成本与保密性使其反而维持封闭。值得玩味的是拉美最成功的独角兽公司几乎都未停留于这一封闭系统，而是采用 Pereira 所称离岸治理：通过特拉华或开曼母公司组织融资与治理，从而选择决策与现金流权利的适用法，并选择争议解决地。这种制度选择已开始转化为诉讼风险——Malca v. Rappi、XP 集体诉讼即为明证。结论是：拉美诉讼生态看似封闭，却通过跨境结构主动接入美国诉讼市场，VC 风险并未消除，只是被重新定向。

articles.title: Stockholder Agreements, Dexit and Contractarianism – Could There Have Been a Better Delaware Response to Moelis?
articles.title_cn: 股东协议、Dexit 与契约主义：特拉华对 Moelis 案是否有更佳回应
articles.affiliations: University of Cambridge Faculty of Law
articles.abstract: West Palm Beach v. Moelis 案中，衡平法院副院长 Laster 认定 NYSE 上市公司 Moelis 与创始人之间的股东协议部分治理条款（含董事会决策否决权）因违反 DGCL 141(a) 而无效——市场惯例让位于制定法。判决引发商界震荡，特拉华立法机关迅速通过 SB 313（后成 DGCL 122(18)）实质上逆转 Moelis 部分立论，但被批为仓促立法、破坏司法判决，Charles Elson 直言其构成特拉华公司法角色的自我毁灭。文章援引 1990 年代英国 Russell v. Northern Bank Development Corp. 案作为镜像：上议院认定股东协议否决权因冻结公司修章权而无效，但事后没有立法回应，原因是律师解读 Russell 案狭义化使其影响可绕过，且 Re Duomatic 原则允许所有股东一致签署的协议获执行；LSE 上市规则本来也禁止 Moelis 式股东协议。作者主张特拉华本可循 Russell 后英国路径，SB 313 应收窄至仅挽救所有股东均为当事人的协议，允许私人公司继续保留合同否决权，公开公司则维持 Moelis 立场；如此既可缓解 Dexit 担忧（不会偏离 Model Business Corporation Act、得州、内华达过远），又维护司法理性。但作者悲观预期：全球去监管趋势下 SB 313 难以逆转。

articles.title: Why the Optional Firm Resists Legal Transplantation
articles.title_cn: 为何可选择型公司抗拒法律移植
articles.affiliations: Goethe-University Frankfurt, House of Finance; SciencesPo
articles.abstract: Yifat Aran 可选择型公司 一文以硅谷的全员冒险、找到宝藏人人有分开篇，论证风险资本支持的初创企业是一组对普通股剩余索取权的或有债权网络；董事会的核心任务已非传统监督，而是保留——通过使上行收益可信来维系人力资本的承诺。特拉华对普通股东看似过度的关怀由此获得功能性辩护：它是匹配资本与人才至高价值项目的选择机制。文章肯定其对美国语境的说服力，但指出欧洲移植的限度：可选择型公司预设一种文化气质——商人气质（priestland 笔下与士兵、圣贤并列的第三种 caste，即竞争、灵活、逐利），而欧洲大陆制度生于士兵-圣贤联盟，难以与个体主义、契约主义的特拉华范式无缝嫁接。借鉴 Alexander Sajnovits 新著对德国公司法集体主义结社法的百年史钩沉以及 Enriques、Nigro、Tröger 关于元规则的既有研究，文章论证可选择型公司构成范式级移植，将根本改变德国公司的集体导向。结论是：欧洲改革无须复制美国范式，应通过耐心锚定资本（ETCI 工具）、使命导向融资、员工利润分享与员工持股（与共同决定制兼容），以及基于权利的数据经济建设可选择型公司的功能性等价物——选择性借鉴，在范式契合处吸收，在不适处自建。

articles.title: What Companies Reward: The Changing Mix of Metrics in Executive Incentive Pay
articles.title_cn: 公司究竟奖励什么：高管激励薪酬中指标的演变组合
articles.affiliations: The Conference Board, Governance & Sustainability Center
articles.abstract: Conference Board 治理与可持续性中心基于美国上市公司样本研究高管激励计划中财务与非财务绩效指标的演变趋势。核心发现在于：财务指标在长期激励计划中仍占主导权重（约 70%-75%），但非财务指标的使用正变得更加精挑细选而非全面撤退——企业并未放弃 ESG 类指标，而是优先保留与业务战略强关联、可被客观验证的项目。非财务指标的进入路径亦呈差异化：客户满意度、员工敬业度、安全事故率等操作性指标渗透率最高，多元与包容、温室气体减排等可持续性指标的渗透则与企业是否处于高敏感行业成正相关。文章对代理顾问机构、薪酬委员会、外部董事具有直接参考价值：一方面回应 ISS、Glass Lewis 对指标过于分散的关切，另一方面提示非财务指标并非软指标，其在短期激励中的份量正向中长期激励延伸。

articles.title: Supreme Court All But Ends Corporate Liability for Aiding-and-Abetting Human Rights Abuses
articles.title_cn: 最高法院实质终结对公司协助教唆人权侵害的二级责任
articles.authors: David Livshiz, Tim Harkness, Beth George
articles.abstract: Freshfields 团队评析美国最高法院在 Cisco Systems, Inc. v. Doe I 中的判决：联邦法院无权依《外侨侵权法》（ATS）创设新的私人诉因，且《酷刑受害者保护法》（TVPA）的协助教唆索赔范围不被认可——足令跨国公司在美国法院因涉嫌协助海外人权侵犯而面临二级责任的风险实质上终结。判决从两方面压缩既有路径：其一，明确 ATS 不允许联邦普通法院为人类所理解的国际法义务创造新的私人救济渠道，扭转自 Filartiga 以来形成的私人执行张力；其二，认定 TVPA 的协助教唆责任需有独立的国内法基础，原告既不能援用 ATS 也不能简单借助 TVPA 主条款包装教唆主张。文章提示对跨国公司的实务影响：尽管风险管理实务不会改变（供应链人权尽职调查、反洗钱、KYC 等合规动因未受波及），但 SEC 披露与人权诉讼之间的传导路径被切断，欧洲《企业可持续性尽职调查指令》（CSDDD/CSDD）下的跨境合规反而变得相对重要——人权议题正式从美国法院出口转向欧洲监管者入口。

articles.title: The Ctrip Case Reveals the Limits of Administrative Interviews in China's Antitrust Enforcement
articles.title_cn: Ctrip 案揭示中国反垄断执法中行政约谈的限度
articles.affiliations: University of Minnesota School of Law (SJD candidate)
articles.abstract: 2026 年 1 月 SAMR 对中国在线旅游平台 Ctrip 启动反垄断调查，7 月开出 51.8 亿元（约 7.2 亿美元）罚单——没收违法所得 16.6 亿元、罚款 35.2 亿元。但案件的反垄断政策意义起始于中央介入之前：2025 年 8 月贵州省市监局、9 月郑州市市监局先后对 Ctrip 实施二选一等行为的行政约谈，发出整改令却成效式微，直至 SAMR 升级处罚。文章剖析三书一函分级框架的核心张力——省级机关在法律上确被授权为先行者，但面对一家全国性垄断平台，其强制合规的资源与权威严重不足。文章提出四方面改革路径：明确升级触发器（如特定时间未整改自动升级）、公开整改时间表以制造声誉压力、要求独立第三方合规审计、对重复或重大不合规则径直启动调查。文章的深层关切是：当企业视约谈为低成本延期手段时，约谈制度本身蜕变为拖延工具而非治理工具。Ctrip 案的真正意义不在于 SAMR 创下罚单纪录，而在于揭示分级框架前端威慑力的不足——检验中国反垄断是否成功的真正问题，不是 SAMR 能否开出天价罚单（已可证明），而是省级机关能否在中央介入之前被认真对待。

articles.title: The Supreme Court Reaffirms Its Embrace of Political Disclosure
articles.title_cn: 最高法院重申对政治披露制度的支持
articles.abstract: Sandstrom 与 Freed 评析最高法院近期在竞选融资领域的一项里程碑裁决：法院出人意料地强烈重申披露制度作为反腐利器的核心地位，预期各州将以本案为楔机强化竞选融资披露规则。文章落点虽在选举法，对公司治理的传导却显著——股东积极主义长期将公司政治支出披露作为公司治理议题推向 SEC 与各州，公司政治问责中心（CPA）等组织主导的股东提案正推动董事会披露政治支出。该裁决意味着公司层面的政治披露规则获联邦最高法院背书，但具体落地仍取决于 SEC 规则与州法互动。文章提示公司实务：公司法务与政府事务部门应重新评估政治支出披露的范围与边界，董事会治理委员会应将其纳入与气候披露、董事会多元化并行的常态化披露议程。

articles.title: Debevoise Discusses Empowering Consumers for the Green Transition Directive
articles.title_cn: Debevoise 解读《赋能消费者绿色转型指令》
articles.authors: John Young, Alfie Scott, Eike Björn Weidner
articles.abstract: Debevoise 团队解析欧盟《赋能消费者绿色转型指令》（ECGTD, Directive EU 2024/825）对企业在向个人消费者销售产品或服务时作出的环境及可持续性声明的实质性变革。核心要点：（1）原则上禁止未经认证的绿色声明（如生态友好、气候中性、绿色等模糊表述），须基于优异环境绩效或公认优良做法的认证计划；（2）禁止基于排放抵消计划的气候中和主张以未来承诺为唯一依托；（3）要求可靠性、可持续性、可循环性等可持续性标签须基于认证体系或由公权力机构设立；（4）禁止将软件或硬件设备的自主能效升级作为核心卖点（除非法律要求）。文章提示合规时间表：成员国转化截止 2026 年 3 月 27 日，适用时间为 2026 年 9 月 27 日。对在欧盟销售产品的跨国公司（包括间接面向消费者的 B2B2C 业务），法务、市场与可持续报告团队需要全面审视环境主张并重构产品包装与营销话术。

articles.title: The Values Primacy Paradigm in Corporate Governance
articles.title_cn: 公司治理中的价值观优先范式
articles.authors: Carliss Chatman, Sergio Alberto Gramitto Ricci
articles.affiliations: Howard University School of Law; Hofstra University Law School
articles.abstract: Chatman 与 Gramitto Ricci 以 Target 公司 2025 年 1 月悄然拆除 DEI 基础设施的事件为切入点，描述美国公司治理中价值观优先（values primacy）范式的退潮与重组。Target 的退出与 Costco 同期持续推进的多元化与包容路径形成镜像对照。作者梳理四种典型路径：完全退出（如 Target）、调整但保留（如沃尔玛）、坚守并制度化（如 Costco、Apple）、以此为核心战略品牌（如 Salesforce）。文章落点在于：股东提案机制、机构投资者代理投票偏好、消费者抵制之间的张力在 2025 年下半年显著重组；公司法层面，董事会在面对社会议题时究竟应优先回应股东、客户、员工还是社会整体利益的传统难题再度浮现。文章从比较视角援引意大利、欧盟成员国关于利益相关者治理的最新立法，论证价值观优先并非简单美式例外主义，而是可被制度设计塑造的治理产物。结论：公司治理的价值观问题不会因一家企业的退出而消解，它会随监管与代理市场的演化持续回归议程。

articles.title: Morrison & Foerster Discusses DOJ Revival of Expedited Second Request Review

articles.authors: Alexander Okuliar, Jeff Jaeckel, Kerry C. Jones, Megan E. Gerking, Michael B. Miller
articles.abstract: MoFo 反垄断团队评析美国司法部反垄断局于 2026 年 7 月 23 日宣布的加速第二请求（Expedited Second Request）调查恢复及配套修订示范时间协议。第二请求是 DOJ 并购审查进入实质调查阶段后向各方发出的正式信息要求，过去十年因耗时过长、范围过宽饱受批评。新机制的预期改进在于：明确第二请求触发与加速路径启动的双重门槛；预设最早的位置陈述提交截止；限制在第二请求启动前与第三方的强制约谈次数。文章落点：第二请求的时间预期重置将改变交易端等待 vs 退出的策略选择，律所并购团队与反垄断团队需重新校准反垄断风险定价模型。MoFo 团队特别提示：参议院司法委员会拟推动的第二请求透明度法案将与新机制形成制度耦合，预订立法窗口在 2027 年第一季度。

articles.title: Attempted Administrative Entrenchment
articles.title_cn: 行政锁定：第二特朗普政府的单向政策固化尝试
articles.affiliations: University of California College of Law, San Francisco (formerly UC Hastings)
articles.abstract: Price 教授以新近论文为底本描述第二特朗普政府在回避国会、避开常规规则制定的前提下追求单边、持久政策变更的锁定策略。识别三种技术创新：（1）结构性去监管——通过解雇员工、扣留资金削弱机构能力，构成 Freeman 与 Jacobs 命名的策略形态，强制继任总统花时间重建；（2）震慑-敬畏式威慑——以超出法律预期的资金切断（如哥伦比亚大学 2.21 亿美元）等手段抬高对方预期违约成本，使未来政治风向变换时机构重新推行多元化等做法的合规成本被人为放大；（3）激活私人诉讼——利用《虚假申报法》（FCA）的检举人机制将大学招生数据、移民合规等议题转化为可被私人原告追诉的请求，使执法被市场力量放大。文章指出这些策略与传统公司治理的章程锁定（如特拉华 203、毒丸、董事会分级制度）在结构上同源——其道德风险也同源：一方得手的策略将激励对手方在未来复制，形成锁定螺旋。结尾警示：跨党派的自我克制早已荡然，行政权锁定已成新常态。

articles.title: The Regulatory Three-Body Problem
articles.title_cn: 监管三体问题：政策偏好、政治激励与法律可辩护性的共同作用
articles.affiliations: Yale Journal on Regulation, Notice & Comment
articles.abstract: Thallam 借用物理学三体问题的隐喻提出核心命题：所有具有相当重要性的联邦法规，其最终形态由政策偏好、政治激励与法律可辩护性三大变量共同决定，仅凭法定文本永远不足以刻画监管产出。文章从白宫监管监督部门任职经历出发，以 2018 年《农业改进法》授权农业部制定的工业大麻规则为例——法定定义极为精确（9-THC 不超过 0.3%），但 0.3% 是否涵盖 0.31%、天气意外超标可否免责、抽样检测方法等执行细节必须由行政部门决定。三大变量深度交织：政策偏好即使政府总体方向一致，具体议题上仍存分歧；政治激励涉及利益集团权衡、发布时机、资源优先级；法律可辩护性并非合法与否的二元判断，而是界定决策空间的边界，需考量规则被挑战的概率、诉讼资格与裁决时机，条约与国家安全惯例亦构成隐性约束。COVID 紧急时期的案例显示：当法律授权薄弱但无人具备诉讼资格与政治动机去挑战、且裁决前政策即已失效，三变量表现为零或近零的逆境均衡。附录引入 Stephenson 与 Tiller & Cross 的博弈论模型，揭示任期临近结束时政治与法律权重的动态消长，并展望建立涵盖国会、机构与法院的行政法统一宪法理论。

articles.title: Can Government Help Create Silicon Valleys? Start With the Intermediaries
articles.title_cn: 政府能催生硅谷吗？从中介层入手
articles.authors: Ofer Eldar, Adair Morse, Ian Sapollnik
articles.affiliations: 加州大学伯克利分校法学院; 加州大学伯克利分校哈斯商学院; 麻省理工学院
articles.abstract: 针对欧洲创新缺口，作者提出政策杠杆不在直接补贴初创企业，而在培育专业化风投中介层。以美国SBIC计划为历史案例：政府通过SBA担保债券向持牌私募基金提供杠杆，投资选择留予私人。基于SBIC持牌人历史登记册与风投交易数据的分析显示，SBIC活动与本地风投活跃度、初创退出、专利相关新设企业及技能劳动需求显著正相关，剔除硅谷等成熟枢纽后效应依然成立；参与过SBIC本地轮次的基金家族后续更可能重返同一地域。创新政策应认真对待中介层：项目设计会影响私人投资者是否习得本地信息并在干预后持续经营。

articles.title: Addressing Valuation as Core Issue of the Private Asset Bubble
articles.title_cn: 估值：私募资产泡沫的核心问题
articles.abstract: 针对私募资产泡沫危及金融稳定的监管共识，作者主张细分判断：部分主体有估值问题，多数主体审慎。问题源于基金规模、2/20薪酬、25%年化回报预期与估值技术的不健康组合：百亿欧元基金今日需约250亿欧元估值退出方能兑现carry，而公开市场每年仅吸收40-50只独角兽。peer-to-peer估值法让少量现金驱动全行业估值上旋；私募市场缺乏做空套利者；退出时点的合谋与资产切片交易可操纵账面价值。作者呼吁提升估值、交易与行业关联性的透明度，使银行监管者、证券监管者与央行更好理解私募市场估值机制与系统性关联。

articles.title: AI Governance for Private Companies
articles.title_cn: 私营公司的人工智能治理
articles.authors: Hillary Flynn, Drew Morales, Courtney Hugger, Caroline Conway
articles.abstract: 近四分之三的公司计划两年内部署代理式AI，但仅约五分之一拥有成熟治理模型。文章梳理五大类AI风险：数据隐私与知识产权、自主行动、可靠性、客户影响与供应商依赖，并分析欧盟《AI法案》与美国分散式监管格局。提出六项最佳实践：明确问责归属、业务目标导向、风险分级管理、数据安全与供应商尽调、客户利益保护、持续监控与故障应对。核心观点：最能从AI获益的公司并非部署最快者，而是能将试验与问责、客户意识和严谨执行相结合的公司。

articles.affiliations: The Conference Board; ESGAUGE; Russell Reynolds Associates; 罗格斯大学法学院公司法与治理中心
articles.abstract: 基于Russell 3000公司2026年上半年投票数据：股东提案量下降约20%，激进主义活动较2024年峰值锐减约75%；Say-on-Pay支持率回升，76%公司获90%以上赞成。SEC工作人员退出Rule 14a-8实质审查，排除请求量下降近50%，公司诉讼风险上升。治理类提案逆势增长近19%（70%由John Chevedden提交）；HCM提案较2024年下降近60%、平均支持率仅6%；反ESG提案支持率几近翻倍至5%。代理权争夺战占激进主义活动比例从7%升至38%，激进投资者转向更具针对性、更高风险策略。

articles.title: The Strategic Blind Spots Attracting Shareholder Activists
articles.title_cn: 招致股东积极主义者的战略盲区
articles.abstract: 2025年全球股东积极主义创纪录（超255起campaign，美国同比增28%）。FCLTGlobal分析美、日、欧100起campaign样本：71%的目标公司缺乏可信的长期路线图（三年期增长与利润率展望、清晰资本配置框架），55%的董事会投入战略议题时间不足；90%的样本公司至少存在其一。Honeywell因无法解释多元化协同价值而数月内宣布拆分是典型案例；日本公司的资本配置不透明为另一高频缺口。只回应激进者具体要求而不弥补战略缺口的公司，往往在激进者退出后回吐收益；长期价值创造是终极防御。

articles.title: Revisiting Delegation and Time
articles.title_cn: 重访授权与时间
articles.abstract: 作者为其圣母大学法律评论研讨会论文撰写的导读，重访与Jonathan Adler 2020年《Delegation and Time》的主张：国会应恢复对联邦机构授权法的定期重新授权。六年来Article II的授权与时间问题之上叠加了Article III的授权与独立判断问题：重大问题学说与Loper Bright独立判断取代Chevron尊重，虽意在驯服行政机构，却使国会立法更难，并引入法院解释违背立法国会、现任国会或两者意志的风险。行政法新均衡下，定期重新授权的重要性不降反升，批评Article II与Article III越权者都应支持。
articles.abstract_cn: 乔作者为其圣母大学法律评论研讨会论文撰写的导读纳森·阿德勒（重访与 Jonathan Adler ） 2020年年《代表团和时间》的主张的授权与独立判断问题：第二国会应恢复对联邦机构授权法的定期重新授权。六年来的授权与时间问题之上叠加了条第三尊重虽意在驯服行政机构条：重大问题学说与 Loper Bright独立判断取代 Chevron却使国会立法更难并引入法院解释违背立法国会、现任国会或两者意志的风险。行政法新均衡下定期重新授权的重要性不降反升 ，第二批评与条第三条越权者都应支持。

articles.title: Liability Management's Limited Runway: Corporate Restructuring Today
articles.abstract: Coercive, non-pro rata debt restructurings—now widely known as “liability management exercises” (LMEs)—have become a central tool for distressed borrowers over the past decade. Proponents argue the coercive LME typically buys a stressed company time to turn around and take off, avoiding bankruptcy and its costs. In a newArticle, we argue that this expectation is overstated. Our thesis is straightforward. Conceptually, the value-shifting nature of coercive LMEs need not produce stable, value-enhancing outcomes: the value shift from frozen-out creditors to participants can matter more to the participating dealmakers than fixing the firm. Their incentives are to take the value shift as long as the attributable firm losses are less than the value shifted. We then search empirically for actual outcomes following these coercive LMEs. The results, based on our hand-collected set of coercive LMEs, contradict the celebratory account: most LME debtors soon default again or file for bankruptcy anyway, and firm-level benefits seem modest overall, with multiple financial markers weakening or not improving. An LME, broadly, is an out-of-court debt renegotiation—yesterday’s “workouts.” In recent years, the neutral LME label has displaced the blunter “creditor-on-creditor violence,” which once described debtors pitting creditor groups against one another and aligning with a winning coalition to elevate participants' priority (“uptiers”) or shift value away from the rest (“dropdowns”) in exch
articles.title_cn: 责任管理的有限跑道：今天的公司重组
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去十年中，强制性、非按比例债务重组（现在被广泛称为“负债管理练习” （ LME ） ）已成为陷入困境的借款人的核心工具。支持者认为，强制性LME通常会为公司争取有压力的时间来扭转局面和起飞，从而避免破产及其成本。在一篇新文章中，我们认为这种期望被夸大了。我们的论文很简单。从概念上讲，强制性LME的价值转移性质不需要产生稳定的、提升价值的结果：从被冻结的债权人到参与者的价值转移对参与交易者来说比固定公司更重要。他们的动机是采取价值转移，只要可归因于公司的损失小于转移的价值。然后，我们根据经验搜索这些强制性LME之后的实际结果。基于我们手工收集的一组强制性LME的结果与庆祝活动相矛盾：大多数LME债务人很快就会再次违约或申请破产，公司层面的利益总体上似乎不大，多个财务指标减弱或没有改善。从广义上讲， LME是一种庭外债务重新谈判，即昨天的“锻炼”。近年来，中立的LME标签已经取代了更直截了当的“债权人对债权人的暴力” ，这种暴力曾经描述债务人将债权人团体相互对立，并与获胜的联盟保持一致，以提高参与者的优先级（ “上升者” ）或在交换中将价值从其余部分转移（ “下拉式” ）

articles.title_cn: 人人享有私募股权：推动私募市场民主化的矛盾动力
articles.abstract: This post was originallypublishedon 28 February 2026 by the Harvard Law School Forum on Corporate Governance. Efforts to open private equity and other private assets to retail investors—including now through 401(k) plans—are often framed as a long-overdue democratization of superior investment opportunities. Indeed, private equity has always been viewed as special, both for its market-beating returns and its success in making companies more profitable, yet it has historically been off-limits to retail investors. InPrivate Equity for All: The Paradoxical Push to Democratize Private Markets, we argue that the push to democratize private equity is subject to a glaring paradox. Far from sharing the spoils of private equity with the public, opening private markets to retail investors at scale is likely to erode or eliminate each and every one of the supposed advantages of private equity over public markets—not just for retail investors but across the market. Consequently, whether private equity’s appeal lies in superior investor returns or superior corporate governance, broad retail access is likely to ensure that neither one is achieved. The debate has become urgent. New products targeting retail investors are continually being launched by private-asset managers and blessed by regulators. articles.abstract_cn: 本文最初于2026年2月28日由哈佛法学院公司治理论坛发布。向散户投资者开放私募股权和其他私人资产的努力--包括现在通过401 (k)计划--通常被认为是早该实现的优质投资机会的民主化。事实上，私募股权一直被视为特殊的，无论是因为它的市场击败回报还是成功地使公司更有利可图，但它在历史上一直是散户投资者的禁区。InPrivate Equity for All: The Paradoxical Push to Democratize Private Markets ，我们认为推动私募股权民主化存在明显的悖论。远非与公众分享私募股权的战利品，大规模向散户投资者开放私募市场可能会侵蚀或消除私募股权相对于公共市场的所谓优势--不仅对散户投资者，而且对整个市场。因此，无论私募股权的吸引力在于卓越的投资者回报还是卓越的公司治理，广泛的零售渠道都可能确保这两者都不会实现。辩论变得十分紧迫。针对散户投资者的新产品不断由私人资产经理推出，并得到监管机构的青睐。2025年夏天，一项行政命令指示美国证券交易委员会和美国劳工部为私募股权进入

articles.title: Control Is Not the Same as Board Leadership: Why Do PE-backed Companies Appoint Outside Chairs?
articles.title_cn: 控制与董事会领导不一样：为什么私募股权支持的公司会任命外部主席？
articles.abstract: Private equity (PE) investors are commonly portrayed as highly active owners. They negotiate extensive control rights, appoint directors, approve major strategic decisions and closely monitor performance. Against this background, one governance choice remains surprisingly underexplored: why do some buyouts appoint a new outside chairperson while others do not? This question matters because a chair is not a mandatory feature of private company boards.  PE sponsors can protect their investment through ownership rights, contractual consent provisions, management incentive alignment, and direct board representation. Concentrated ownership might therefore appear to make a separate external board leader unnecessary. Yet new outside chairs remain common in practice. Our findings suggest that these appointments are not simply a staffing decision. They appear to be a deliberate governance choice in PE-backed buyouts. Our study examines 1,065 UK PE-backed buyouts completed between 2004 and 2018, sponsored by 331 PE firms and tracked through 2024. The hand-collected dataset comprises 7,627 firm-year observations and detailed information on board composition, chair appointments, operating performance, and add-on acquisitions. Approximately 61 per cent of the sample buyouts had a chair at some point during the holding period, while 39 per cent appointed a new outside chair after the buyout. articles.abstract_cn: 私募股权（ PE ）投资者通常被描述为高度活跃的所有者。他们就广泛的控制权进行谈判，任命董事，批准重大战略决策并密切监控绩效。在这种背景下，一个治理选择仍然令人惊讶地未被充分挖掘：为什么有些收购公司会任命一位新的外部董事长，而另一些则不会？这个问题很重要，因为椅子不是私人公司董事会的强制性特征。私募股权发起人可以通过所有权、合同同意条款、管理激励调整和直接董事会代表来保护其投资。因此，集中所有权似乎使一个单独的外部董事会领导者变得没有必要。然而，在实践中，新的室外椅子仍然很常见。我们的调查结果表明，这些预约不仅仅是人员配置的决定。在私募股权支持的收购中，它们似乎是深思熟虑的治理选择。我们的研究调查了2004年至2018年期间完成的1,065项英国私募股权支持的收购，这些收购由331家私募股权公司赞助，并追踪到2024年。手工收集的数据集包括7,627个公司年份的观察结果以及有关董事会组成、主席任命、运营绩效和附加收购的详细信息。大约61%的样本收购在持有期间的某个时间点有一把椅子，而39%的样本收购在收购后任命了一把新的外部椅子。我们将新的外部椅子定义为在收购后被任命为椅子的个人

articles.title: LPACs Are Gaining Authority, But Not Accountability
articles.title_cn: LPAC正在获得权力，但不是问责制
articles.abstract: Over the last decade, continuation funds have become an important component within the private equity market. The increased use of secondary transactions has been accompanied by concerns about the role played by General Partners (GPs) in structuring these alternative vehicles. Prior research has studied the dual agency problem that arises when GPs act on both sides of the transaction. There has been some debate about the effectiveness of the Limited Partner Advisory Committees (LPACs) in reducing conflicts of interest. On the one hand, the monitoring view argues that stronger committee oversight and tighter feasibility thresholds can reduce GP opportunism. On the other hand, a nascent empirical literature suggests that concentrated LPAC representation, close continuing GP–LP relationships, and specific side letter protections may shield GPs from effective scrutiny. In theirnew research, Yaron Nili and Elisabeth de Fontenayshed light on these two conflicting views by examining whether variation in LPAC composition and contractual design is associated with systematic differences in formal LPAC authority. Using a dataset of 217 fund governance documents from one large institutional investor, including 155 LPAs, the authors document that LPACs address GP–LP conflicts through consent, waiver, and approval rights. articles.abstract_cn: 在过去十年中，持续基金已成为私募股权市场的重要组成部分。二级交易使用的增加伴随着对普通合伙人（ GP ）在构建这些替代车辆方面所起作用的担忧。先前的研究已经研究了当全科医生在交易双方采取行动时出现的双重代理问题。关于有限合伙人咨询委员会（ LPAC ）在减少利益冲突方面的有效性存在一些争议。一方面，监测观点认为，更强有力的委员会监督和更严格的可行性阈值可以减少GP机会主义。另一方面，新出现的经验文献表明，集中的LPAC表示、密切的持续GP-LP关系和特定的边字母保护可能会保护全科医生免受有效的审查。在他们的新研究中， Yaron Nili和Elisabeth de Fontenays通过检查LPAC组成和合同设计的变化是否与正式LPAC权威的系统差异有关，阐明了这两种相互矛盾的观点。作者使用来自一家大型机构投资者的217份基金治理文件（包括155份LPA ）的数据集，记录了LPAC通过同意、放弃和批准权来解决GP-LP冲突。同时，这种结构可能在内圆和外圆LP之间产生第二冲突。证据表明， LPAC治理结构具有影响力

articles.title: ‘Made in Europe’ or ‘Made to Measure’? The Legal Fault Lines of the Industrial Accelerator Actby: Luciano Magaldi Sardella, Matteo Mantuano
articles.abstract: TheIndustrial Accelerator Act, proposed by the European Commission in March 2026 and now subject to trilogue negotiations, promises to reforge European industrial policy around a single, deceptively simple idea: preference for what is ‘Made in Europe’. Yet behind this slogan lies a thicket of legal ambiguities, jurisdictional tensions, and trade-law vulnerabilities that may render the Act’s most ambitious provisions as fragile as they are attractive. The Council’s recent‘partner origin’ compromise, circulated under the Irish presidency in late July 2026, does not resolve these tensions but it redistributes them. The ambition and its discontents TheIndustrial Accelerator Act (IAA), formally presented as COM(2026) 100, is the legislative centrepiece of the Commission’sClean Industrial Deal. Its declared ambition is to reverse a decade of deindustrialisation by lifting manufacturing’s share of European Union gross domestic product from 14.3 per cent in 2024 to 20 per cent by 2035—a target first articulated in theDraghi reporton European competitiveness and since elevated to the status of political gospel. To achieve this, the Act introduces ‘Made in EU’ and low-carbon preferences across public procurement and public support schemes, targeting strategic sectors including steel, cement, aluminium, batteries, solar panels, heat pumps, and electric vehicles.

articles.title_cn: “欧洲制造”还是“量身定制” ？《工业加速器的法律故障线》作者： Luciano Magaldi Sardella、Matteo Mantuano
articles.abstract_cn: 欧盟委员会于2026年3月提出的《工业加速器法案》（ Industrial Accelerator Act ）目前正在进行三方谈判，该法案承诺围绕一个看似简单的想法重塑欧洲工业政策：偏好“欧洲制造”。然而，在这个口号的背后是一堆法律模糊性、管辖权紧张和贸易法漏洞，可能使该法案最雄心勃勃的规定既脆弱又有吸引力。理事会最近于2026年7月下旬在爱尔兰总统任期内发布的“伙伴起源”妥协方案并没有解决这些紧张局势，而是重新分配了这些紧张局势。雄心壮志及其不满工业加速器法案（ IAA ） ，正式称为COM （ 2026 ） 100 ，是委员会清洁工业协议的立法核心。其宣布的雄心壮志是通过将制造业在欧盟国内生产总值中的份额从2024年的14.3 ％提高到2035年的20 ％来扭转十年的去工业化，这一目标首先在德拉吉关于欧洲竞争力的报告中得到阐述，自此提升到政治福音的地位。为实现这一目标，该法案在公共采购和公共支持计划中引入了“欧盟制造”和低碳偏好，针对包括钢铁、水泥、铝、电池、太阳能电池板、热泵和电动汽车在内的战略行业。

articles.title: Position Limits in Commodity Derivatives: A Quantitative Regulatory Technique for the Efficiency of Financial Markets?by: Luca Orciani
articles.abstract: Position limits in commodity derivatives rank among the most distinctive and least explored innovations of MiFID II. In my recent article published in theCapital Markets Law Journal(available open accesshere), I offer a systematic and exegetical analysis of the EU position limits regime, reconstructing its genesis and rationale, its material and personal scope, along with the controversial, highly technical calculation methodology, and the complementary position reporting apparatus. The study ultimately raises a broader policy question: is a quantitative regulatory technique, one constraining market conduct through numerical thresholds, the optimal tool for curbing excessive speculation, or does it risk introducing undue rigidity into the system and hindering the development of commodity derivatives markets? The regime originates in the far-reaching changes in commodity markets in the early years of this century. Once a niche instruments through which producers and merchants transferred price risk to counterparties willing to bear it (a mechanism reflecting the socially useful, liquidity-preserving function of speculation), commodity derivatives became a destination for return-seeking institutional investors, with a marked intensification of financial speculation and raw material price volatility. The G20 commitments of Pittsburgh (2009) and Cannes (2011) prompted the EU legislator to move away from the disclosure-centred paradigm of MiFID I. The genesis of Article 57 MiFID I

articles.title: Oppression or Involuntariness? Reassessing the Marketability Discount in Bharti Telecomby: Hardik
articles.abstract: Earlier this year, the Supreme Court of India in the case ofPannalal Bhansali v Bharti Telecom Ltdupheld a selective reduction of capital undersection 66 of the Companies Act 2013, which cancelled shares of the company’s minority shareholders and approved a 25% discount for lack of marketability (DLOM) in valuing those shares. This post builds on the contention that because the court found no oppression, it treated‘fair value’and‘fair market value’as similar, thereby allowing a marketability discount. It argues that it is the wrong trigger, and the approach is too broad. Under the same logic, a minority shareholder who never wanted an exit could also receive a discounted price simply because the majority chose to use section 66, under which there is no requirement of mandatory valuation by an independent valuer.Bharti Telecom,converts a fact-sensitive inquiry into a legal rule by making the applicability of a DLOM dependent upon the existence of oppression. articles.abstract: Welcome to Street Level , my new series on Liberty Street Economics . As research director, I try to keep track of the wide range of work that the economists at the New York Fed produce. articles.abstract: Monetary policymakers closely monitor the term structure of sovereign bond yields to uncover market participants’ beliefs about the future monetary policy stance, inflation, and activity. A particular object of interest is the natural real rate of return, or “r-star,” which acts as a guide for monetary policy decisions. Numerous papers have questioned how much information investors possess, and how precisely they know r-star. In this post based on a recent Staff Report , we explore what the term structure of interest rates can teach us about r-star and its perception by investors.

articles.affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
articles.abstract: This post concludes a three-part series on how bank regulation interacts with the organizational structure of banking firms. The first post documented the equity-rich nonbank subsidiaries inside bank holding companies (BHCs); the second post showed that BHCs met Basel III by reallocating capital internally, moving equity from nonbank affiliates to bank subsidiaries rather than raising new external capital. Here we ask what that reallocation meant for financial stability. The series draws on the authors' recent Staff Report, " Regulatory Arbitrage Within the Firm ."

The first post documented that nonbank subsidiaries inside bank holding companies (BHCs) are large, equity-rich "reservoirs," and that bank-level capital diverged sharply from consolidated capital after Basel III took effect in 2015. This post asks why, and traces the answer through the internal plumbing of the holding company. The series draws on the authors' recent Staff Report, " Regulatory Arbitrage Within the Firm ."

articles.affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
articles.abstract: How has the recent implementation of tariffs affected small businesses? Due to lack of data, little is known about this issue. In this Liberty Street Economics post, we use data from the 2025 edition of the Small Business Credit Survey (SBCS) to explore this question for businesses nationally and in the Second District (defined, for the purpose of this study, as New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut). We find that the majority of national firms in the goods and retail sectors reported experiencing financial challenges due to tariffs in 2025, with even larger shares of regional firms doing so.

articles.title: Simpler guidance, more effective supervision European banking supervision has reviewed over 130 publications to make them more concise and user friend
articles.authors: Frank EldersonMember of the ECB's Executive Board
articles.abstract: By Frank Elderson, Member of the Executive Board of the ECB and Vice-Chair of the Supervisory Board of the ECB European banking supervision has reviewed over 130 publications to make them more concise and user‑friendly. Around 40 will be discontinued, others have been revised in a targeted manner, and several are undergoing a more in-depth review, including the guide on governance and risk culture. We have also developed concrete initiatives as part of our supervisory culture program on the use of guides in the supervisory dialogue. The prudential framework sets out the legal requirements that banks must meet. Within that framework, banks remain responsible for putting in place governance, risk management and control arrangements that are appropriate to their size, business model and risk profile. This is precisely where supervisory guidance adds value. European banking supervision has a perspective that no individual bank can have. Across banks’ diverse business models, structures and risk profiles, we see where risks build up, where recurring weaknesses arise and where particular approaches appear to work well. By sharing these insights through guides, methodologies, letters and reports, we ensure consistency in our supervisory approach, help banks understand the issues supervisors will examine and bring to light good practices observed across the sector. This is why supervisory guidance is an important part of transparent and effective supervision.

articles.title: Saxon Woods Investments Ltd v Costa: A Warning to Maverick Directorsby: Duncan Henderson
articles.abstract: History is littered with examples of high-profile leaders who were sure they were right until disaster struck. Honest people’s judgments can become misguided or even delusional. According to legend or Hollywood, Captain Edward Smith took The Titanic full steam ahead into an ice field believing it couldn’t sink.  In the corporate context, Adam Neumann drove WeWork into a frenzy of long-term leases and debt-fuelled expansion; Richard Fuld at Lehman Brothers kept doubling down on mortgage-backed risk. The Supreme Court’s decision inSaxon Woods Investments Ltd v Costais a sharp reminder that section 172 of the Companies Act 2006 is not a safe-harbour for ‘I know best’ directors. Francesco Costa (director and chairman of the board of Spring Media Investments) genuinely believed that delaying the sale of the business would maximise value for him and other shareholders. But instead of arguing that case openly at board level, he sidelined his colleagues, kept the investment bank’s true mandate to himself and quietly steered the process away from the agreed timetable. When Covid struck, the value of the company collapsed. The Court’s decision confirms that the section 172 duty to promote the success of the company is a loyalty-based duty with an objective ‘good faith’ component that governs what directors do and how they go about doing it. articles.title: Why Prediction Markets and Securities Markets Require Different Regulatory Prioritiesby: Jonathan R. Macey, Luca Enriques
articles.abstract: Prediction markets are in the regulatory crosshairs. In the United States, within the span of a few months this year, federal prosecutors brought the first criminal insider trading case involving an event contract against an Army master sergeant with a top-secret clearance who allegedly traded on classified information about an upcoming military operation. Next the CFTC and DOJ pursued a Google engineer who made about $1.2 million trading contracts on Google’s unreleased ‘Year in Search’ rankings. A House Oversight Committee investigation and at least eight bills in the 119th Congress quickly ensued. Most of the legislative proposals envision importing some version of insider trading law from securities markets to prediction markets. In a newpaper, we argue that adjustments in regulatory approach should be made to reflect the very profound differences between securities markets and prediction markets. The case for strict insider trading regulation in securities markets does not automatically translate to prediction markets. The distinctive regulatory challenge that prediction markets do present is that some, but not all, contracts on prediction markets create a serious moral hazard of giving market participants an incentive to engage in corrupt, illegal, or dangerous actions in order to rig the outcome of the contract on the prediction market. articles.title: Asset Manager Capture
articles.title_cn: 资产管理人的俘获
articles.abstract: One of the most significant corporate governance developments of the past half-century is the rise of asset managers with large ownership stakes that provide them with outsized influence over public companies. As asset managers have grown in size, concerns about their potential to capture the government and secure favorable regulation have increased as well. In this Article, however, we describe an equally important risk that runs in the other direction: large asset managers are vulnerable to “reverse capture,” whereby government actors can pressure them to deploy their governance power in service of the government’s agenda. This dynamic has intensified as presidential power has expanded over several decades. Expanded presidential authority not only enables administrations to bypass legislative and independent agency processes for regulating asset managers but also allows the White House to harness asset managers’ quasi-regulatory power to promote its agenda. These dynamics have implications not only for U.S. corporate governance and asset manager fiduciary duties, but also for global investors who rely on American asset managers. They also pose a democratic concern: government actors may increasingly pursue policy through concentrated private intermediaries rather than through more transparent and accountable channels.
articles.abstract_cn: 过去半个世纪以来最重要的公司治理发展之一是资产管理人的崛起——他们持有巨额所有权，对上市公司产生了超出比例的影响力。随着资产管理人规模的增长，关于它们可能俘获政府并获取有利监管的担忧也随之增加。然而，本文描述了一个向相反方向运行的同等重要风险：大型资产管理人容易遭受“反向俘获”——政府行为体可以施压令其为政府议程服务的方式运用治理权。随着几十年来总统权力的扩张，这一动态不断加剧。扩张的总统权力不仅使各届政府能够绕过立法和独立机构对资产管理人的监管流程，还允许白宫利用资产管理人的准监管权力来推动其议程。这些动态不仅影响美国公司治理和资产管理人信义义务，也影响依赖美国资产管理人的全球投资者。同时，它们还带来民主层面的担忧：政府行为体可能越来越多地通过集中的私人中介而非更透明、更具问责性的渠道来推行政策。

articles.title: Corporate Governance Scandals in India's Banking and Financial Services Sector
articles.title_cn: 印度银行与金融服务领域的公司治理丑闻
articles.abstract: In this chapter, we adopt a sector-specific approach to corporate scandals in one jurisdiction, namely India, to examine how corporate governance factors contributed to the scandals on the one hand and how the scandals have either resulted in governance reforms or merit further legal or regulatory transformations on the other. In doing so, we train our sights on the banking and financial services (BFS) in India. After highlighting the specific attributes in governance for BFS companies, including in the Indian context, we outline our aims for the chapter and briefly set out its roadmap. We explore three research questions. First, we consider whether and how poor corporate governance norms and practices contributed to the BFS scandals in India over the last decade. This is essentially the contribution question. Second, we explore the reforms, if any, that were introduced to the laws and regulations relating to corporate governance in the aftermath of these scandals. This covers the reformation question. Finally, we deliberate on reforms that are still required to be carried out based on the learnings from these governance scandals in BFS companies: the normative question. In examining our research questions, while we focus on the governance scandals in BFS companies in India, we seek to make comparisons to international examples to the extent necessary. We structure our chapter essentially along the lines of three broad contributive factors that have led to scandals in BFS companies in India, and highlight the reformative and normative factors relating to each of them. For each, we select one case study involving a recent governance scandal in a BFS company in India within the last decade. The YES Bank episode (2020) illustrates the risks of star-promoter control, excessive risk-taking and wealth tunnelling. The IndusInd Bank accounting scandal (2025) highlights the failure of internal and external gatekeepers, particularly the board and auditors. The IL&FS crisis (2018) demonstrates how regulatory fragmentation, regulatory arbitrage and inter-regulatory turf wars can contribute to systemic failure. Taken together, the cases demonstrate that these governance failures require more than piecemeal responses, calling instead for a wholesale reconsideration of the corporate governance framework applicable to BFS companies.
articles.abstract_cn: 本章采用部门导向的方法，以印度为单一司法管辖区，考察公司治理因素一方面如何导致了丑闻，另一方面这些丑闻如何促成了治理改革或如何有必要进一步进行法律或监管变革。我们将焦点置于印度银行与金融服务（BFS）领域。在强调BFS公司治理的特殊属性（包括印度语境下）之后，我们概述了本章的目标和路线图。我们探讨了三个研究问题。第一，不良的公司治理规范和实践在何种程度上、以何方式导致了过去十年印度BFS丑闻——这是“成因”问题。第二，丑闻之后引入了何种治理改革——这是“改革”问题。第三，基于这些治理丑闻的经验教训，仍需推行哪些改革——这是“规范”问题。我们以三大成因因素为线索组织本章，并对每个因素选取一个近十年内印度BFS公司治理丑闻的案例。YES Bank事件（2020）展示了明星发起人控制、过度冒险和财富隘道的风险；IndusInd Bank会计丑闻（2025）突出了内部和外部看门人（尤其是董事会和审计师）的失败；IL&FS危机（2018）展示了监管碎片化、监管套利和监管机构间的地盘争夺如何导致系统性失败。综合来看，这些案例表明，治理失败需要的不仅仅是头痛医头、脚痛医脚的补丁式回应，而是需要对BFS公司适用的公司治理框架进行全面重新审视。

articles.title: Can Purpose Survive the Buyer in M&A? The Structure Decides
articles.abstract: When a mega corporation buys a purpose-driven company, the rationale is usually the same: the buyer acquires authenticity and a reputational boost, while the target company gains capital and scale. After the press release announcing the deal, however, the situation can change rapidly. Whether purpose survives post-closing depends on the corporate and economic structure of the transaction. The allocation of decision rights, financial incentives, and oversight mechanisms determines whether the attributes that justified the acquisition are preserved or gradually absorbed into the mega corporation’s operating model. Lucian Bebchuk and Roberto Tallarita, writing in theCornell Law Review, examined public commitments to stakeholders and concluded that they were “mostly for show”. Their finding shifts the question from what a buyer publicly commits to in theory to what the deal effectively entails in practice. Mission drift is prevented by the mechanisms still in force the day after closing. Good and bad examples Coca-Cola’s acquisition of Innocent Drinks is widely cited as a successful integration between a mega corporation and a purpose-driven company. The transaction was staged as a minority stake in 2009, majority control in 2010, and more than 90% by 2013, with the founders retaining operational control through the transition years. Innocent still commits 10% of its profits to social and environmental causes and was certified as a B Corporation in 2018.
articles.title_cn: 并购中目的能否在买方手中存续？结构决定一切
articles.abstract_cn: 当大型企业收购一家目的驱动型公司时，理由通常如出一轸：买方获得真实性和声誉提升，目标公司获得资本和规模。然而，在宣布交易的新闻稿发布之后，情况可能迅速变化。目的是否能在交割后存续，取决于交易的公司和经济结构。决策权、财务激励和监督机制的分配，决定了证明收购合理性的那些属性是被保留，还是被逐渐吸收进大企业的运营模式中。Lucian Bebchuk和Roberto Tallarita在《康奈尔法律评论》中考察了对利益相关者的公开承诺，结论是它们“多半只是做做样子”。他们的发现将问题从买方在理论上公开承诺什么，转向交易在实践中究竟意味着什么。使命漂移是由交割后次日仍在生效的机制所阻止的。好的和坏的例子：可口可乐收购Innocent Drinks被广泛援引为大型企业与目的驱动型公司之间成功整合的案例。该交易分阶段进行—2009年收购少数股权，2010年取得控股权，2013年达到90%以上——创始人在这段过渡期内保留了运营控制权。Innocent至今仍将其10%的利润用于社会和环境事业，并于2018年获得了B Corporation认证。

articles.abstract_cn: 在一项对英国诉讼融资市场具有重大影响的判决中，高等法院确认破产管理人可以签订诉讼融资协议，并在符合破产管理目的时，向融资方支付优先于所谓“超级优先权”债权人的款项。该判决为Re Cross Transport Ltd (In Administration) [2026] EWHC 1636 (Ch)，由ICC法官Jones于2026年6月30日作出，解决了一个在破产市场中日益突出的矛盾——这一问题不仅存在于英国，也存在于其他适用类似破产规则的司法管辖区。

articles.title: Decentralization: The Search for a Legal Definitionby: Salvatore Luciano Furnari
articles.abstract: Decentralization is the criterion on which the regulatory treatment of decentralized finance ultimately depends, yet no legal instrument defines it. In a recentpaper, I argue that this definitional vacuum is the root cause of the uncertainty surrounding decentralized protocols and so I propose a legal definition resting on three cumulative and verifiable criteria: the presence of at least three independent decision-making centres; the structural interdependence of participants within a protocol-governed environment; and the non-custodial nature of the infrastructure. A threshold criterion without content The most legally significant reference to decentralization in EU law is Recital 22 of theMarkets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA), under which crypto-asset services provided ‘in a fully decentralised manner without any intermediary’ fall outside the scope of the Regulation. The concept is therefore decisive, but it appears only in a recital: no operative provision refers to protocols or to the offering of decentralized services, and no definition is supplied.
articles.authors: Author(s):Salvatore Luciano FurnariPhD at the University of Roma Tor Vergata and Fintech and MiCAR lawyer with a focus on blockchain, crypto-assets, and DeFi
articles.title_cn: 去中心化：法律定义的探索
articles.abstract_cn: 去中心化是决定去中心化金融监管待遇的标准，然而没有任何法律文件对其作出定义。在近期论文中，笔者论证了这一定义真空是不确定性的根源，并提出了一个基于三个累积且可验证标准的法律定义：至少存在三个独立的决策中心；参与者在协议治理环境中的结构性相互依赖；以及基础设施的非托管性质。欧盟法律中对去中心化最具法律意义的引用是《加密资产市场监管条例》（MiCA）序言第22条，其中规定以“完全去中心化方式且无任何中介”提供的加密资产服务不在该条例范围之内。因此这一概念具有决定性，但它仅出现在序言中：没有任何操作性条款提及协议或去中心化服务的提供，也未提供任何定义。

articles.title: Anti-Woke Corporate Governance
articles.abstract: In the modern era, corporate law has not been viewed as particularly partisan. To some extent, this is likely due to the fact that Delaware, the dominant state for the generation of corporate law, has built nonpartisanship into its corporate law design. Recently, however, Texas has begun to position itself as a competitor to Delaware by offering an explicitly conservative corporate governance platform. The approach has had some success, drawing big name companies to the state such as Exxon, Dell Technologies, and Coinbase. This Essay, written for SMU's Irving L. Goldberg Symposium: Welcome to Y'all Street: Texas Corporations and Texas Shareholders, will discuss the background and nature of Texas's strategy, as well as the risks and benefits of red state/blue state corporate governance, both to corporations and to the corporate chartering system in general. articles.title: Stakeholder Engagement and ESG in China
articles.abstract: China’s state-led stakeholder model can generate genuine corporate activism and ESG influence, but its effectiveness depends on strong institutional channels and remains vulnerable to political gatekeeping Conventional accounts treat stakeholder engagement in China as largely formalistic, a product of concentrated ownership, pervasive state control, and an immature capital market. This article challenges that assessment. Drawing on documented activism cases, practitioner interviews, and comparative analysis of US, UK, and EU frameworks, it demonstrates that China has developed a distinct model of state-led stakeholder empowerment. This model constitutes a pluralistic ecosystem. Its outcomes cannot be reduced to symbolic compliance or bureaucratic command. Its internal logic differs fundamentally from both the market-driven US approach and the compliance-oriented EU framework.

articles.title: Protracted Processes and the Timing of Disclosure After the Listing Actby: Filippo Annunziata
articles.abstract: The Listing Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/2809) and Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/789 have recast one of the most debated questions in EU capital markets law: when must an issuer disclose inside information that emerges gradually, over the course of a merger, an authorisation procedure, or any other transaction that unfolds in stages? In arecent paper, I set out the new regime and defend an inclusive construction of its central—and undefined—notion, the ‘protracted process’: a participation test, rather than a control test. The story begins with the Court of Justice’s decision inGeltl v Daimler, which held that intermediate steps in a protracted process may themselves constitute precise inside information. MAR codified that holding, with the consequence that one and the same notion of inside information governed both the insider dealing prohibition and the duty of disclosure: information mature enough to trigger the trading ban simultaneously fell due for publication, subject only to a delay under Article 17(4). The predictable response was systematic recourse to delay, extensively documented in ESMA’s MAR Review. The Listing Act converts that fragile market equilibrium into a rule of positive law. articles.title: Challenging Banking Agency Examination Results
articles.abstract: As part of a broader shift in the regulatory landscape, federal banking agencies are working to make exams more objective and financial in focus.  For example, the Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (“FFIEC”) recently released a notice of proposed rulemaking that would revise the Uniform Financial Institutions Rating System, commonly known as the CAMELS rating system, for the first time in thirty years.  The proposed revisions would ensure that the rating system “focuses on an institution’s financial condition and risk profile, with emphasis on material financial risk.”[1]  This shift in regulatory posture represents a course correction from the previous Administration’s supervisory posture, particularly following heightened regulatory scrutiny after Silicon Valley Bank and Signature Bank were placed into Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation receivership in March 2023.

monthly_reports.summary: 2026年7月，六大来源共收录 91 篇文章（含首期 37 篇与后续各期增量）。SEC 监管权重构、特拉华公司法重塑与并购研究的微观机制深化构成全月主线，AI 治理与气候责任议题同步从原则讨论走向操作化。
trends: SEC 监管改革从落地进入攻防：注册发行改革、Regulation E-Delivery、半年度报告提案相继推进，影子SEC 小组发出系统性质疑，Atkins 主席重申信息披露监管者定位；叠加最高法院 OT2025 系列判决（Slaughter 推翻 Humphrey's Executor、Cook 保留美联储结构独立、Learning Resources 否定 IEEPA 关税授权）与 CFIUS 正当程序底线首次司法确认，行政监管权在立法、司法与市场三方之间重新配置。
特拉华公司法进入重塑期：Cisco 案削弱 Caremark 监督义务，SB21 修订后 DGCL §144/§220 的五大关键变化进入实施消化，Zync v. Porsche 首次承认合同否决权股东亦可能承担忠实义务违反责任，并购与董事义务教义在司法、立法与市场三层联动中重构。
并购与股东积极主义的微观机制深化：ECGI MARC 会议系列连续输出（投标人机会主义、续借风险、进口相关并购），CLS 以实体性理论重新解释收购溢价，共同所有权与自动化研究推动劳动力市场进入反垄断分析视野。
AI 治理从原则讨论走向操作化：非律师董事使用生成式 AI 的证据开示分歧、印度破产程序 AI 证据认证漏洞、欧盟适格性测试的能力塑造效应与 OECD 准则五十周年反思，标志 AI 议题全面进入公司治理与金融监管的操作层面。
气候与公司责任的复合治理：TotalEnergies 法国警惕义务判决、披露-诉讼-市场预期复合治理框架与 ESG 披露工具论，构成跨大西洋的智识呼应，监管义务与公司能力的张力成为新焦点。

monthly_reports.label: 2026年8月
monthly_reports.summary: 2026年8月，七大来源共收录 112 篇文章。股东权力光谱在 SEC 政策转向后全面再校准，特拉华公司法在监督义务与契约主义之间持续重塑，监管收缩、私募市场制度供给与反垄断执法加码构成全月主线。
trends: 股东权力光谱再平衡：SEC 退出 no-action 审查推高投票提案数，半年度报告提案遭遇超 20 万封评论信，影子SEC、Rule 14a-8 请愿书与强制股东仲裁研究交织；2026 代理季复盘显示反 ESG 提案人推动董事长-CEO 分离浪潮，CPA 政治披露提案获强支持，股东机制各环节同步再校准。
特拉华公司法主导叙事：Caremark 监督义务教义重构与波音案恶意门槛重申、Verisk/AccuLynx 案命令特定履行 2.35 亿美元合并、Dropbox 迁册案测试 Maffei 晴天规则边界、Moelis 后 SB 313 的契约主义回应与 sandbagging 大规模实证，从监督义务到并购救济再到设立地竞争全面展开。
监管收缩与执法重校准：SEC 规则司法审查实证显示 Gensler 时代规则 85.7% 被法院推翻，申报人身份简化、电子交付条例与新设财务报告执法组相继落地，美联储 1979 年以来首次全面修订 Regulation O，监管国家在 Loper Bright 时代的再定位持续发酵。
私募市场与资本结构成为制度供给焦点：私募股权强制披露论证、ESG 评级重形式轻实质、双重股权日落条款交易所禁令批判、加速回购在 Rule 10b-18 安全港内的扭曲悖论、私募资产估值泡沫与 SBIC 中介层实验，非公开市场机制设计全面进入研究视野。
反垄断执法在中美两端同步加码：Google 搜索垄断救济进入 Pay for Half 付费上限方案阶段，DOJ 恢复加速第二请求审查以重置并购确定性，中国 SAMR 在 Ctrip 案创下 51.8 亿元罚单，劳动力市场正式进入并购与反垄断分析核心。
AI 治理从公司工具变为规制对象：JPMorgan 以内部 AI 取代代理顾问、披露文件面向 AI 读者起草、FINRA 式审计自我监管能否适用于前沿 AI 的合宪性难题，AI 从公司治理工具转变为被治理与规制的对象。
